title: KMRL Vacancy 2026 - 70 Trade, Graduate and Technician Apprentice PostsKMRL Vacancy 2026
qualification: Applicants must have completed a full-time regular four-year B.Tech or B.E. degree in one of the engineering disciplines notified by KMRL.
salary: The monthly stipend depends on the apprentice's qualification category. Graduate apprentices receive Rs. 12,300, diploma apprentices Rs. 10,900 and ITI trade apprentices Rs. 9,600. An additional Rs. 1,200 per month is payable as food/messing allowance.
age_limit: KMRL requires apprenticeship applicants to have completed 18 years of age. Candidates below 18 years are not eligible.
application_fee: Kochi Metro Rail Limited has confirmed that there is no application fee for the Apprenticeship Programme 2026-27.

title: SGOU Vacancy 2026 - 32 Assistant Professor PostsSGOU Assistant Professor Vacancy 2026
qualification: Master’s degree with a minimum of 55% marks (or equivalent grade) in a concerned / relevant / allied subject from an Indian University, or an equivalent degree from an accredited foreign University.
